title: Veil-Then-Reveal: Protecting PII Privacy via Reversible Pseudo-Anonymization in Zero-Trust User--LLM Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.22800v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly process sensitive documents and personal information, yet sending prompts containing personally identifiable information (PII) to remote providers exposes data subjects and organizations to risks from logging, retention, model training, and unintended disclosure. Existing anonymization methods often mask or remove PII, while conventional encryption eliminates the lexical and structural cues needed for effective LLM processing. We present Veil-then-Reveal (VtR), a user-side PII pseudo-anonymization framework for privacy-preserving LLM interaction under a zero-trust threat model. VtR treats remote LLM providers as untrusted and sends only pseudo-anonymized prompts, keeping plaintext PII on the user. VtR first detects PII and replaces it with realistic, same-type, in-vocabulary surrogates before prompts leave the user's device, preserving their linguistic and structural properties. translated_title: 先遮后露（Veil-Then-Reveal）：在零信任的用户与大语言模型交互中通过可逆伪匿名化保护个人身份信息隐私
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益被用于处理敏感文档和个人信息，然而向远程服务提供商发送包含个人身份信息（PII）的提示词，会使数据主体和组织面临日志记录、数据留存、模型训练以及意外泄露等风险。现有的匿名化方法通常会遮蔽或删除PII，而传统的加密方式则会消除LLM有效处理所依赖的词汇和结构线索。我们提出了Veil-then-Reveal（VtR），这是一个在零信任威胁模型下实现隐私保护LLM交互的用户侧PII伪匿名化框架。VtR将远程LLM提供商视为不可信方，仅发送经过伪匿名化处理的提示词，而将明文PII保留在用户端。VtR首先检测PII，并在提示词离开用户设备之前，将其替换为真实的、同类型、存在于词表中的替身词，从而保留提示词的语言与结构特性。它结合……
tldr: 提出用户侧可逆伪匿名化框架Veil-then-Reveal（VtR），在零信任威胁模型下将提示词中的PII替换为同类型的真实替身词以保护隐私，同时保留语言与结构特性使LLM仍能有效处理，明文信息始终保留在用户端。
en_tdlr: Veil-then-Reveal (VtR) is a user-side reversible pseudo-anonymization framework that, under a zero-trust threat model, replaces PII in prompts with realistic, same-type, in-vocabulary surrogates before they leave the user's device, preserving linguistic and structural cues for effective LLM processing while keeping plaintext PII local.
